title: Reject cyclic interface inheritance before object-model layout IR emission
feature: object model metadata IR lowering diagnostics

diagnostics.message: cyclic Objective-C interface inheritance cannot produce a stable ivar layout

mode_matrix.name: native-ir-negative
abi_requirements: FinalizeObjcProgramPropertyIvarLayoutClosure emits O3P150 for cyclic inheritance before runtime metadata export
invalid inherited layouts do not reach emit_ivar_descriptor_section as valid descriptor records
runtime metadata export remains fail-closed when sema cannot provide a stable layout replay key

negative_requirements: no @__objc3_meta_ivar_offset_* globals are accepted as authoritative for cyclic inheritance input
no runtime property/ivar descriptor should be treated as layout_valid for the rejected cycle
the diagnostic is deterministic and independent of declaration traversal order
